verdict.rationale: React's own docs and README say React Native and Expo let you build React apps for iOS and Android with truly native UIs (react-docs-5, react-gh-2). React Native DevTools integrates React Developer Tools (react-docs-35), and React describes itself as the library for 'web and native user interfaces' (react-probe-1). The native-mobile delivery runs through the companion React Native/Expo projects rather than core React, and performance and code-sharing details are thin. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of mobile runtime performance, documentation on how much web code can be reused on mobile, and independent hands-on corroboration.
